title: Scheduled live-catalog check and IDOR sample of unguarded admin-client actions
detail: Adds scripts/maintenance/live-catalog.mjs and a token-gated step in the weekly maintenance sweep that reads production pg_catalog: RLS off on a public table (PostGIS spatial_ref_sys accepted) and backup-shaped tables that still grant to anon or authenticated. This is the shape SEC-002 slipped past every migration-text gate. IDOR sample, 2026-10-26: of 345 use-server files, 12 import the admin client without an obvious authz helper by name; all 12 read by hand, plus 6 that only authenticate by name. Each is gated by a staff gate, a capability check, an ownership check or a self-scoped query. No unguarded action found. The 68 actions without parseInput were not part of this sample.

verify.evidence: Probe passes on this branch; unit tests added alongside (lib/net/pinned-fetch.test.ts, scripts/maintenance/live-catalog.test.ts).
